1.do: `k set image deploy/api nginx=nginx:1.27 -n app`, because left of `=` is the container name (nginx), not the deployment
`k get pods -n app`, because without `-n app` kubectl looks in default and says 'No resources found'

1.dont: Editing or deleting the broken pod directly
1.do: Fix the deployment with `k set image deploy/api ...`, because the deployment keeps recreating the pod from its own template

2.do: `k logs <pod> -n app --previous`, because it shows the crashed container's output, not the fresh, still empty one
`k edit deploy api -n app`, because the deployment owns the pod and replaces any pod you edit

2.dont: Misaligning the items of the `command:` list in vim
2.do: Indent every `command:` item evenly (`- sleep`, `- "3600"`), because broken indentation makes kubectl reject the edit

3.do: `k set resources deploy api -n app --requests=cpu=100m`, because the scheduler places pods by their requests, not their limits
`k set resources deploy api -n app ...`, because the deployment owns the pod and recreates it from its template

3.dont: Checking `k get pods -n app` once, right after the fix
3.do: Rerun `k get pods -n app` until the Pending pod is gone and the new pod shows 1/1 Running

4.do: `systemctl enable --now kubelet`, because enable makes it start after a reboot; check with `systemctl is-enabled kubelet`
`ssh node01` first and check the prompt says node01, because the broken kubelet is on node01

4.dont: Running `k get nodes` while still inside node01
4.do: `exit` first, then `k get nodes`, because kubectl is set up only on the control plane

5.dont: Editing the service file, then only `systemctl restart kubelet`
5.do: `systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart kubelet`, because systemd rereads changed service files only after daemon-reload

5.dont: Editing the first `ExecStart` block shown by `systemctl cat kubelet`
5.do: Edit `/usr/lib/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf`, because that drop-in file holds the bad `/usr/local/bin/kubelet` path

5.dont: `systemctl restart kubelet` without fixing the path
5.do: Change `/usr/local/bin/kubelet` to `/usr/bin/kubelet` (see `which kubelet`), because the service points to a file that does not exist

6.dont: `k label pod <pod> -n web ...` to match the service
6.do: `k set selector svc backend-svc app=backend -n web`, because the service selector is wrong, not the pods
Use only `app=backend` as selector, because pod-template-hash changes on every rollout and the service would lose its pods
`k exec client -n web -- wget -qO- -T 3 backend-svc`, because the busybox client has wget but no curl

7.dont: Changing `port:` in `k edit svc backend-svc -n web`
7.do: Change `targetPort:` to 80, because targetPort is the pod's port (nginx listens on 80); port is the service's own port

7.dont: `k delete svc backend-svc -n web`, then `k expose` again
7.do: `k edit svc backend-svc -n web`, because the task forbids recreating the service

7.dont: Seeing endpoints listed and assuming the service works
7.do: Read the port after the IP in `k get endpoints backend-svc -n web`, because a wrong targetPort still lists endpoints

8.dont: `k logs` or `k get pods` while the API server is down
8.do: `crictl ps -a | grep kube-apiserver`, then `crictl logs <id>`, because kubectl needs a working API server to answer

8.dont: Restarting kubelet or moving the manifest after editing
8.do: Save `kube-apiserver.yaml` and wait up to 60 s, because kubelet watches the manifests folder and restarts the pod itself
`--etcd-servers=https://127.0.0.1:2379`, because 2379 is etcd's client port; 2380 is only for etcd members talking together

9.dont: `k delete pod test` and creating it again
9.do: Fix the scheduler, because `k describe pod test` shows `Node: <none>`: nothing is placing pods, the pod itself is fine
`vim /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-scheduler.yaml` (`kube-schedulerx` to `kube-scheduler`), because it is a static pod built from that file

9.dont: `systemctl restart kubelet` after saving the manifest
9.do: Just save the file and wait, because kubelet notices the change and restarts the scheduler by itself

10.do: `from: - podSelector: matchLabels: run: client`, because a namespaceSelector lets in every pod of those namespaces
`spec.podSelector: matchLabels: app: backend`, because spec.podSelector picks the protected pods; the client goes under `from:`

10.dont: Keeping `- Egress` in policyTypes from the docs example
10.do: `policyTypes: - Ingress` only, because Egress with no egress rules blocks all outgoing traffic of the backend pods

10.dont: Pasting into vim without `:set paste`, or `dd` in insert mode

11.dont: `k get pods | grep dns` in the default namespace

11.dont: `k delete pod` on CoreDNS pods that do not exist

Add `--rm` to `k run t ...`, because it deletes the test pod t when the command ends
`nslookup kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local`, because busybox can print NXDOMAIN for the short name even when DNS works

12.do: `k top pods -A --sort-by=cpu`, because `-A` compares pods in all namespaces, not only default
`echo <first-row-pod-name> > /opt/top.txt`, because the file must hold only the pod name
`k logs api -n app > /opt/api.log`, because pod api lives in namespace app, not default

12.dont: Ignoring the 'Defaulted container' message from `k logs`
12.do: Add `-c <container>` when the question names a container, because otherwise kubectl picks the first container for you

13.do: `--serviceaccount=dev:deploy-bot`, because kubectl needs the format <namespace>:<name> and refuses the short one

13.dont: A typo like `--role=deploy-manger` in the rolebinding

14.do: `k create clusterrolebinding node-viewer-binding --clusterrole=node-reader --serviceaccount=ops:node-viewer`, because nodes are cluster-wide, so a RoleBinding grants nothing

14.dont: Worrying about `-n ops` on clusterrole and clusterrolebinding

15.do: `helm template my-argo argocd/argo-cd ... > /root/argo-helm.yaml`, because the task wants the YAML only, not an install
`--set crds.install=false`, because this chart makes CRDs from templates; `--skip-crds` only skips the chart's crds/ folder

15.dont: `helm template my-argo argocd/argo-cd` without version or namespace

16.do: `--set controller.replicaCount=2`, because grep shows several replicaCount keys and only the one under controller: is right

16.dont: Expecting REVISION 1 in `helm history web -n demo` after rollback

16.dont: Trying to fix EXTERNAL-IP `<pending>` on the controller Service

18.do: `k get crd | grep cert-manager > /root/crds.txt`, because certificates are objects; the task wants the CRD types themselves
`k explain certificate.spec.subject > /root/subject.txt`, because subject sits inside spec

18.dont: Typing the output into the file by hand
18.do: Redirect with `> /root/subject.txt`, because it copies the exact output with no typos

19.do: Put the 4 lines in `/etc/sysctl.d/k8s.conf`, then `sysctl --system`, because `sysctl -w` is lost after reboot
`systemctl enable --now cri-docker`, because the service is named cri-docker, even though the package is cri-dockerd

19.dont: Retyping the 4 kernel parameters by hand
19.do: Copy and paste the 4 lines from the question, because one typo means that setting is not applied

`k create -f <tigera-operator URL>`, because apply stores a huge annotation and fails with 'Too long'
Set `cidr:` to the `--cluster-cidr` of kube-controller-manager, because pod IPs must match the cluster's pod range

21.do: `apt-get update`, then `apt-cache madison kubeadm`, because otherwise apt says the version is not found

`kubeadm upgrade node` on node01, because `upgrade apply` is only for the control plane node

21.dont: Skipping the kubelet restart after installing the new kubelet

21.dont: `k drain node01` or `k uncordon node01` while inside node01

22.do: `--cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key`, as listed by `grep cert-file` in etcd.yaml

22.dont: Panicking when kubectl is silent after saving etcd.yaml

23.dont: Lining up `ports:` with the dash of `- image:`

`--class=nginx` (name from `k get ingressclass`), because without a class no controller picks up the Ingress

25.dont: Changing `type: PathPrefix` to `Prefix` in the HTTPRoute

Keep only `- podSelector: matchLabels: app: api` under `from:`, because a namespaceSelector item lets in pods from other namespaces
`policyTypes: - Ingress` only, because Egress with no rules blocks all outgoing traffic of the db pods

Allow `protocol: UDP` and `protocol: TCP` on `port: 53`, because DNS also uses TCP, for example for large answers
Add `namespace: prod` under metadata, because otherwise the policy lands in default

28.dont: Editing the ConfigMap and stopping there

`k run t --image=busybox:1.36 ...`, because the task asks for that exact image

31.dont: Adding `volumeMounts:` only to the log-shipper container

`effect: NoSchedule`, because the value is case-sensitive

Add `-n shop` to every command, because deployment web lives in namespace shop

`ssh cka01001` first, because each exam task runs on its own cluster
